sloka: स श्रुत्वा पुरुष व्याघ्रम् रामम् विषयम् आगतम् ।वृद्धैः परिवृतः अमात्यैः ज्ञातिभिः च अपि उपागतः ॥२-५०-३४॥
transliteration: sa śrutvā puruṣa vyāghram rāmam viṣayam āgatam ।vṛddhaiḥ parivṛtaḥ amātyaiḥ jñātibhiḥ ca api upāgataḥ ॥2-50-34॥

translations.english: Hearing that Rama, the tiger among men, had come to his realm, he came attended by the elders, by his ministers and by his kinsmen.
